title: The Trying the Wide Brush
youtube_title: The Trying the Wide Brush | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Being new at something is not the same as failing.
summary: At a library story circle, Vera feels shy about a wide brush that felt too bold. Instead of pretending not to care, Vera tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie June stays kind and does not push for a show.
